before.title: Inside Marseille’s Devastating Plague of 1720
before.description:
In 1720, the Grand Saint-Antoine reached Marseille after a voyage through the eastern Mediterranean. This film follows the ship’s return, the quarantine decisions at the port, the spread of plague through Marseille, and the ship’s final fate near the island of Jarre.

proposed_description:
In May 1720, the Grand Saint-Antoine returned to Marseille after people had died aboard. Its valuable cargo and passengers entered quarantine close to the city, while the danger of plague remained.

Follow the ship’s voyage, the decisions made at Marseille’s port, the epidemic that followed, and the fate of its captain and vessel.
